snippet.title: INDOORS: Trespasser - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play for free October 9th.

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4546740/INDOORS_Trespasser/

May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to search for his parent in this short horror and detective escape room.
